description: Agile project management over MCP: kanban boards, epics, roadmap, retrospectives, whiteboards, wiki and delivery metrics as 49 tools on a hosted server, with OAuth sign-in from the client.
rules: The AgileHero MCP server is hosted at https://mcp.agilehero.io/mcp and speaks Streamable HTTP. There is nothing to install and no API key: the user signs in with their own AgileHero account from the client over OAuth 2.1, and the client must support Client ID Metadata Documents.
Every id parameter and every id in a response is a short uid returned by a list, get or search tool. Never invent or guess a uid.
Most tools need a project uid. Call list_projects first to resolve workspaces and projects instead of asking the user to paste one.
All rich text (wiki pages, card and epic descriptions, comments) is AgileHero Markup: strict XML with a closed vocabulary, never markdown and never HTML. Call get_ahm_spec once before writing any.
Rich-text edits are two-step by design: call preview_description_update or preview_wiki_page_update first, then pass the returned preview_token to update_description or update_wiki_page.
Use move_card rather than update_card to change a card's list or position; an empty list_id means the backlog.
On update tools prefer the add_* and remove_* delta fields for collections. The plain collection fields replace the prior state and cannot be combined with their deltas.
Wiki, whiteboard, retrospective and roadmap tools require the project's workspace to be on a Pro or trial plan. Every other tool works on the Free plan.
Tool calls are metered per user per workspace: 500 a day on Free, 5,000 on Pro or trial, reset at 00:00 UTC.
